从 S 到 E 的任意路径，允许重复格子
统计迷宫中所有开放格子的数量
把所有可能路径按长度排序返回

Any path from S to E, even if it revisits cells
Count every open cell in the maze

q: 最合适的核心算法是什么？
q_en: What is the best core algorithm?
options: BFS 按层扩展
Dijkstra 用权重堆
回溯枚举所有路径
拓扑排序
options_en: BFS, expanding layer by layer
Dijkstra's algorithm with a weighted heap
Backtracking that enumerates every path
Topological sort
why: 无权图最短路就是 BFS；第一次到达终点的层数已经是最短距离。
why_en: BFS is the right choice because every grid move has equal cost, so the first time it reaches the end is shortest.
whenOtherWins: 如果边有不同权重或启发式估价有价值，Dijkstra 或 A* 才更合适；这里所有移动都是单位代价。
tradeoff: BFS 层级扩展 vs Dijkstra 带权最短路

termDefinitions.meaning: 按层扩展的图搜索算法，用队列保证先发现的节点先被处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BFS, or Breadth-First Search, expands nodes layer by layer using a queue so earlier-discovered nodes are processed first.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按累计代价从小到大扩展节点的带权最短路算法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dijkstra's algorithm expands nodes in order of increasing cumulative cost to solve weighted shortest paths.

termDefinitions.meaning: 深度优先尝试每个分支、失败就撤销重试的穷举搜索方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backtracking explores each branch depth-first and undoes a choice whenever it fails.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把有向无环图的节点按依赖顺序排列的算法，不用于求最短路径。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Topological sort orders the nodes of a directed acyclic graph by dependency and does not solve shortest-path problems.

optionExplanations: 等权移动下，BFS 按层扩展，第一次碰到终点就是最短距离，不用维护优先队列。
有不同权重时才用 Dijkstra 的优先队列去换取正确性；这里所有移动代价一样，多付出 log 开销却没收益。
回溯会穷举所有路径再挑最短，时间随格子数指数增长，规模一大就跑不完。
拓扑排序解决的是依赖顺序问题，不管路径长度，跟最短路无关。
optionExplanations_en: Equal-cost moves mean the BFS layer count doubles as the path length, so whichever branch touches the end first already carries the minimum step count — no priority queue required.
Dijkstra's heap earns its keep only when edges carry different weights; here all moves cost the same, so the log overhead buys nothing.
Backtracking enumerates every path before picking the shortest, and its cost grows exponentially with maze size.
Topological sort orders dependencies, not path length, so it doesn't solve shortest path at all.

why_en: BFS needs a queue for the frontier, a visited set to avoid duplicates, and parent pointers to reconstruct the path.

q: 关于 parent map 重建路径，哪些说法正确？（多选）

options: start 的 parent 通常设为 None
从 E 沿 parent 往回走会得到终点到起点的反向链
最后需要 reverse 才能得到 S 到 E 的顺序

termDefinitions.meaningEn: A queue is a first-in-first-out waiting list; BFS uses it to hold the frontier of cells still to expand.

optionExplanations: 对：用 None 当哨兵，回溯循环遇到它就知道走到了起点，该停下了。

Correct: parent only points to a predecessor, so walking it from the end naturally yields a reversed chain first.
Correct: that reversed chain needs one reverse() call to become the proper start-to-end order.
Wrong: the queue only holds cells still waiting to be processed; getting a free path would require copying it on every enqueue, which costs more.

scenario: 100×100 迷宫里每格有四个邻居，同一个格子会被多个邻居先后发现。
scenario_en: In a 100-by-100 maze each cell has four neighbors, so several of them can discover the same cell.
q: 为什么 BFS 中更推荐在「入队时」标记 visited，而不是出队时才标记？
q_en: Why is it better to mark visited when enqueueing in BFS instead of when dequeueing?
options: 出队才标记会导致 BFS 完全找不到任何可行路径
入队标记反而会让最终路径变得更长
入队标记能防止同一格重复入队
visited 标记只能写在入队这一步，出队时标记语法上不允许
options_en: Marking on dequeue would make BFS fail to find any path at all
Marking on enqueue would make the final path noticeably longer
Marking on enqueue stops the same cell from being queued twice
visited marking is only legal at enqueue time; marking at dequeue is not valid syntax
why: 如果出队才标记，同一格可能在被处理前从多个方向重复入队，答案仍可能正确但队列和扩展次数会膨胀。
why_en: Marking on enqueue prevents duplicate queue entries for the same cell before it is processed.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  N[Neighbor found] --> Seen{In visited?}
  Seen -->|yes| Skip[Skip]
  Seen -->|no| Mark[Mark visited now]

termDefinitions.meaning: 记录已经处理过的节点集合，防止 BFS 重复扩展同一格。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The visited set records already-processed nodes so BFS never expands the same cell twice.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先进先出的等待处理列表，BFS 用它保存待扩展的 frontier。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A queue is a first-in-first-out waiting list; BFS uses it to hold the frontier of cells still to expand.

optionExplanations: 夸大了：出队才标记依然能找到路径，只是同一格可能被多次入队，变慢而已。
错：标记时机不会改变最短路径的长度，只影响效率。
对：一格被标记后，其他邻居再遇到它就不会重复入队，扩展次数保持每格一次。
错：两种时机在语法上都合法，这里比的是效率不是能不能写。
optionExplanations_en: Overstated: dequeue-time marking still finds a path — it just lets the same cell get queued more than once, so it's slower, not broken.
Wrong: marking timing changes nothing about path length, only efficiency.
Correct: once a cell is marked at enqueue time, other neighbors that reach it later skip re-adding it, so each cell is expanded exactly once.
Wrong: both timings are syntactically valid Python; the real difference is efficiency, not what compiles.

scenario: 你正在写无权迷宫 BFS，`neighbor` 是当前格子的合法邻居。
scenario_en: You are writing BFS for an unweighted maze, and `neighbor` is a legal neighbor of the current cell.
q: 哪段更新逻辑最符合文章里的 BFS 模板？
q_en: Which update block best matches the BFS template?
options: queue.append(neighbor); parent[current] = neighbor  # 没检查 visited 是否已访问，且 parent 的方向被写反，回溯会整体失败
if neighbor not in visited: visited.add(neighbor); parent[neighbor]=current; queue.append(neighbor)
if neighbor in visited: queue.append(neighbor)  # 条件判断反了，只对已经访问过的格子重复执行入队操作，从来发现不了新格子
parent[neighbor] = None; visited.clear()  # 每一步都清空已有的搜索进度和访问记录，相当于把 BFS 重置回起点重新开始
options_en: queue.append(neighbor); parent[current] = neighbor  # no visited check at all, and parent's direction is written backward, so backtracing fails entirely
if neighbor not in visited: visited.add(neighbor); parent[neighbor]=current; queue.append(neighbor)
if neighbor in visited: queue.append(neighbor)  # the condition is inverted, so it only re-enqueues cells already visited and never finds anything new
parent[neighbor] = None; visited.clear()  # wipes all visited and parent progress every single step, effectively resetting BFS back to the start
why: 未访问邻居要立刻标记、记录前驱并入队；这三步共同保证每个格子最多扩展一次且可重建路径。
why_en: A newly discovered neighbor should be marked visited, given a parent pointer, and enqueued exactly once.
whenOtherWins: 如果边有权重，不能用 FIFO queue 承诺最短，需要用按累计代价排序的优先队列。
tradeoff: 先标记后入队保证一次扩展 vs 省略检查简化代码但重复膨胀

termDefinitions.meaning: 先进先出的处理顺序，队列的核心语义。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FIFO, First In First Out, means the first element added is the first one removed.

optionExplanations: 错：没检查 visited 就直接入队，还把 parent 方向写反，回溯时会走错路。
对：这正是标准三步——判重、挂前驱、入队，缺一步都会引入 bug。
错：条件写反了，只对已经访问过的格子重复入队，永远发现不了新格子。
错：每一步都清空 visited 和 parent，等于让 BFS 从头重新搜索，进度全部作废。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong: it skips the visited check entirely and assigns parent backward, so backtracing later would walk the wrong way.
Correct: this is the standard three-step move — check unvisited, attach the predecessor, then enqueue; skip any step and bugs creep in.
Wrong: the condition is inverted, so it only re-queues cells already visited and never discovers anything new.
Wrong: clearing visited and parent every step wipes out all search progress, forcing BFS to restart from scratch.

q: 把 BFS 找到最短路径的流程排成正确顺序：

steps: 弹出当前格子并检查是否是 E
用 parent 从 E 回溯到 S 并反转路径

queue 为空仍未找到 E 时返回 None

why_en: BFS initializes from the start, expands layer by layer, reconstructs on reaching the end, and returns null if the frontier is exhausted.

q: list 版 BFS 和 deque+set 版 BFS 的关键差异是什么？
q_en: What is the key difference between list-based BFS and deque-plus-set BFS?
options: 算法相同，list 的 `pop(0)` 和 membership 都是线性成本
list 版本质上不是标准 BFS，只有 deque 版才算真正的 BFS
deque 版无法像 list 版一样记录 parent 前驱信息
引入 set 之后遍历顺序会变得不可预测和错误
options_en: The logic is identical, but list's `pop(0)` and membership are both linear-cost
The list version is not really BFS; only the deque version counts as true BFS
The deque version cannot record parent predecessor info the way list does
Introducing a set makes the traversal order unpredictable and wrong
why: 两版搜索逻辑一样，性能差距来自底层容器操作；队头删除和线性 membership 会把总成本推到平方级。
why_en: The BFS logic is the same, but list front-pop and list membership are linear operations that create quadratic behavior.
tradeoff: O(1) 常数容器操作 vs O(n) 线性容器操作

termDefinitions.meaning: 支持两端 O(1) 插入删除的容器，Python 用 collections.deque 实现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A deque, or double-ended queue, supports constant-time insertion and removal at both ends.

termDefinitions.meaning: 判断某个元素是否在集合/列表里的操作。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Membership checking tests whether an element already exists in a set or list.

termDefinitions.meaning: 记录每个节点是从哪个节点走过来的字典，用于回溯重建路径。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A parent map records each node's predecessor so the path can be reconstructed by walking backward.

optionExplanations: 对：两个版本的搜索步骤完全相同，差距全部来自容器操作复杂度——pop(0) 和 membership 检查都是线性的。
错：两版都是标准 BFS，只是底层容器不同，算法本身没有区别。
错：parent 是独立的字典，谁来实现 queue 跟它没有任何关系。
错：set 只负责 visited 查重，遍历顺序始终由 queue 的 FIFO 语义决定。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: both versions run identical search steps; the gap comes entirely from container cost — pop(0) and membership are both linear.
Wrong: both versions are standard BFS; only the underlying containers differ, not the algorithm.
Wrong: parent is a separate dict, completely unrelated to which container backs the queue.
Wrong: the set only handles visited lookups; traversal order is still governed by the queue's FIFO semantics.

scenario: queue 用 Python list 实现，visited 也用 list 实现；V 记为迷宫格子总数。
scenario_en: The queue is a Python list, visited is also a list, and V is the total number of maze cells.
q: 使用 Python list 做 queue 并用 list 做 visited 时，完整 BFS 的实际复杂度会退化到什么量级？
q_en: If both queue and visited are Python lists, what complexity does full BFS degrade to?
options: O(log V)
O(V)
options_en: O(log V)
O(V)
O(V squared)
why: `pop(0)` 会移动剩余元素、`neighbor in visited` 会线性扫描，两者都是 O(V) 操作，在 V 个格子上各触发一次，合计 O(V^2)；这决定了大迷宫必须换成 O(1) 容器才能通过测试预算。
why_en: Using list pop from the front and list membership makes many BFS operations linear, so the total work grows to O(V squared).

termDefinitions.meaning: 描述算法运行时间或空间随输入规模增长趋势的记号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Big-O notation describes how an algorithm's time or space grows as the input size increases.

termDefinitions.meaning: 图或网格里的节点（格子）总数，是复杂度公式里的规模变量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: V denotes the number of vertices, or cells, in the graph — the size variable in complexity formulas.

线性是两个容器都 O(1) 时的目标量级；这里 pop(0) 和 in visited 各自还带一层 V。
对：V 个格子各触发一次 O(V) 的队头搬移和线性 membership，乘起来就是平方级。
常数时间只描述单次操作，不可能是遍历整张图的总量级。
optionExplanations_en: Logarithmic growth would mean halving the candidates each step, but BFS has to visit every reachable cell.
Linear is the target once both containers are O(1); here pop(0) and `in visited` each add another factor of V.
Correct: each of the V cells triggers one O(V) head shift and one O(V) membership scan, which multiplies out to quadratic.
Constant time describes a single operation, never the total cost of traversing the whole graph.

scenario: list 版 BFS 在 10×10 迷宫上瞬间返回，换到 100×100 就慢了两个数量级。
scenario_en: The list-based BFS returns instantly on a 10-by-10 maze but is two orders of magnitude slower at 100-by-100.

q_en: What are the main performance problems in the list-based BFS? (Select all that apply.)

`neighbor in visited` 需要扫描 visited 列表
parent map 的查找必然是 O(V)
小迷宫可能掩盖这些成本

checking `neighbor in visited` scans the visited list
parent map lookups are always O(V)
small mazes can hide these costs

Correct: `in visited` on a list compares one by one, another O(V) scan.
Wrong: parent is a dict with average O(1) lookups, unrelated to either list problem.
Correct: on tiny mazes these costs stay small enough to go unnoticed until the maze grows.

scenario: BFS 需要频繁从队头取元素，并从队尾加入新元素，不能让出队移动所有剩余元素。
scenario_en: BFS repeatedly removes from the front and appends at the back, so dequeue cannot shift all remaining elements.
q: 在 Python 中最合适的队列容器是什么？
q_en: What is the best queue container in Python?
options: `list` + `pop(0)` 逐个搬移
`set` 随机弹出，无序

对：当墙处理会拒绝掉本来合法的进入方向，漏掉真正存在的路径。
对：两种做法的根源都一样——把只该按 move 判断的规则错当成单格属性。
错：至少有一种简化会返回错误或缺失的路径，正确性保不住。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: treating it as open lets illegal-direction moves through, so BFS can walk into a move that should be rejected.
Correct: treating it as a wall rejects entries that were actually legal, losing a path that should exist.
Correct: both mistakes share the same root — a move-level rule misclassified as a cell-level property.
Wrong: at least one of the two simplifications returns a wrong or missing path, so correctness isn't preserved.

scenario: 需要在 neighbor generation 中判断从 `frm` 到 `to` 的移动方向，位置有 row 和 col。
scenario_en: Neighbor generation must check the movement direction from `frm` to `to`, and each position has row and col.
q: 哪段方向向量计算符合文章描述？
q_en: Which direction-vector calculation matches the described rule?
options: dx = to.col - frm.col; dy = to.row - frm.row
dx = frm.col - to.col; dy = frm.row - to.row
dx = to.row - frm.row; dy = to.col - frm.col
dx = len(to); dy = len(frm)
options_en: dx = to.col - frm.col; dy = to.row - frm.row
dx = frm.col - to.col; dy = frm.row - to.row
dx = to.row - frm.row; dy = to.col - frm.col
dx = len(to); dy = len(frm)
why: 文章用列差作为 dx、行差作为 dy；`>` 的合法进入方向就是 `(1, 0)`。
why_en: The move direction uses column difference for dx and row difference for dy.
whenOtherWins: 如果代码库把坐标命名为 x/y 而不是 row/col，可以换写法，但必须保持方向语义一致。
tradeoff: 以目标减来源的方向向量 vs 反向或轴互换的错误写法

termDefinitions.meaning: 描述一次移动方向的 (dx, dy) 数值对，用来判断能否进入方向格。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A direction vector is the (dx, dy) pair describing a move's direction, used to check entry into a directional cell.

termDefinitions.meaning: 根据当前格子生成所有合法邻居的逻辑，墙、边界、方向规则都在这里判断。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Neighbor generation is the logic that produces every legal neighbor of a cell, checking walls, bounds, and directional rules.

optionExplanations: 对：用目标减来源，列差当 dx、行差当 dy，`>` 算出来正好是 (1, 0)。
错：来源减目标会让符号整体反过来，所有方向判断都会被拒绝或放行反了。
错：行差和列差的位置换了，dx/dy 的轴对调，方向判断全部出错。
错：位置对象的长度和移动方向没有关系，这不是有效的计算方式。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: target minus source, column difference as dx and row difference as dy, giving `>` exactly (1, 0).
Wrong: source minus target flips every sign, so every legality check comes out backward.
Wrong: row and column differences are swapped onto the wrong axis, breaking every direction check.
Wrong: a position object's length has nothing to do with movement direction — this isn't a valid computation at all.

q: 把判断一次移动是否合法的检查顺序排成合理顺序：
q_en: Put the checks for whether a move is legal in a reasonable order:
steps: 若目标是 `>` 或 `<`，根据移动方向检查是否允许进入
计算从当前格到目标格的方向向量
先确认目标坐标在边界内
拒绝墙 `#`
通过后把目标作为合法 neighbor 返回
why: 边界和墙是基础过滤；方向规则需要源、目标和目标格类型都已知后才能判断。
why_en: A legal-move check filters bounds and walls first, then applies directional-entry rules before returning the neighbor.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  Candidate[Candidate move] --> Bounds[Check bounds]
  Bounds --> Wall[Check wall]
  Wall --> Dir[Check direction rule]
  Dir --> Visit[Check visited]
  Visit --> Queue[Add to queue]

termDefinitions.meaning: 描述一次移动方向的 (dx, dy) 数值对，用来判断能否进入方向格。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A direction vector is the (dx, dy) pair describing a move's direction, used to check entry into a directional cell.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只能从特定方向进入的格子，迷宫里用 > 或 < 表示。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A one-way passage is a cell that can only be entered from one specific direction, marked > or < in the maze.

scenario: directional_blocked 用例里 S 四周被墙和单向格封死，E 落在另一片区域。
scenario_en: In the directional_blocked case, walls and one-way cells seal S off while E sits in another region.
q: 如果 S 所在区域被墙或方向限制封住，BFS 会如何结束？
q_en: If the region around S is blocked by walls or direction rules, how does BFS finish?
options: 扫描完整个矩阵后一定会抛出异常终止，程序无法继续运行
只扩展 S 可达的格子，queue 空后返回 None
会强行穿墙径直走到 E，无视合法性检查
返回最后访问的格子作为路径，不管它是不是 E
options_en: It always throws an exception after scanning the whole grid, and the program can't continue
It only expands cells reachable from S and returns None once the queue empties
It forces a path straight through walls to reach E, ignoring legality checks
It returns the last visited cell as the path, whether or not it's actually E
why: BFS 只探索可达区域；frontier 耗尽说明没有合法路径能到 E。
why_en: BFS exhausts only the region reachable from S and returns null when the frontier empties before reaching E.

termDefinitions.meaning: BFS 当前这一层还没扩展的格子集合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The frontier is the set of cells at the current BFS layer that have not been expanded yet.

optionExplanations: 错：题目要求的是返回空值，不是抛异常终止。
对：BFS 只会把可达区域扩展完，queue 空了就说明到不了 E，返回空值。
错：BFS 从不会违反邻居生成给出的合法性约束，不可能穿墙。
错：最后访问的格子通常不是 E，不满足『路径』这个返回契约。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong: the requirement is to return null, not raise an exception.
Correct: BFS only ever expands the reachable region, so an empty queue means E is unreachable and null is returned.
Wrong: BFS never violates the legality that neighbor generation already enforces, so it can't cut through walls.
Wrong: the last cell visited usually isn't E, so it fails the contract of returning an actual path.

scenario: 迷宫里每一步合法移动的代价都是 1，没有沼泽、传送门这类带权格子。
scenario_en: Every legal move in this maze costs exactly one; there are no weighted cells like swamps or portals.
q: 为什么这题不需要 Dijkstra？
q_en: Why does this problem not need Dijkstra's algorithm?
options: 因为图没有任何边
因为每次合法移动的代价相同，BFS 的层数就是路径长度
因为 Dijkstra 不能处理网格
因为 parent map 只适用于 BFS
options_en: Because the graph has no edges at all
Because every legal move costs the same, so BFS's layer number is already the path length
Because Dijkstra cannot operate on a grid
Because a parent map only works with BFS
why: Dijkstra 解决非负加权最短路；本题所有移动等价，BFS 已经按距离递增扩展。
why_en: Dijkstra is unnecessary because equal-cost moves make BFS expand states in increasing path length already.
tradeoff: 等权移动用 BFS vs 非负权重用 Dijkstra

termDefinitions.meaning: 按累计代价从小到大扩展节点的带权最短路算法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dijkstra's algorithm expands nodes in order of increasing cumulative cost to solve weighted shortest paths.

termDefinitions.meaning: 记录每个节点是从哪个节点走过来的字典，用于回溯重建路径。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A parent map records each node's predecessor so the path can be reconstructed by walking backward.

optionExplanations: 错：迷宫格子间显然存在可移动的边，前提本身就不成立。
对：所有移动代价一样时，BFS 按层扩展本来就等价于按距离递增，Dijkstra 的堆开销白花。
错：Dijkstra 技术上完全能跑在网格图上，只是这里没必要用它。
错：parent map 是通用的路径重建手段，两种算法都可以用。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong: the maze clearly has edges between cells, so the premise itself fails.
Correct: when every move costs the same, BFS's layer order already equals increasing distance, so Dijkstra's heap overhead buys nothing.
Wrong: Dijkstra can technically run on a grid graph; it's just unnecessary here.
Wrong: a parent map is a general-purpose reconstruction technique usable by either algorithm.

scenario: 你需要返回完整路径，但不想在 queue 的每个元素中复制一整条 partial path。
scenario_en: You need to return the full path, but you do not want to copy a full partial path into every queue entry.
q: 更合适的做法是什么？
q_en: What is the better approach?
options: 用 parent map，每个格子只存一个前驱
在每个 queue entry 里保存 path + [neighbor]
只保存总长度，不保存任何前驱
把路径存在 visited set 中
options_en: Use a parent map so each cell stores only one predecessor
Store path + [neighbor] inside every queue entry
Only keep the total length, with no predecessor tracking
Store the path inside the visited set
why: parent map 把路径复制成本推迟到找到 E 后的一次回溯；队列里复制路径会在热循环里做大量重复工作。
why_en: Parent pointers avoid copying partial paths on every queue push and reconstruct the route once at the end.
whenOtherWins: 如果只做小图原型，复制 path 写起来更直观；大图或性能题应优先 parent map。
tradeoff: 延迟复制的 parent map vs 逐节点复制路径

termDefinitions.meaning: 记录每个节点是从哪个节点走过来的字典，用于回溯重建路径。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A parent map records each node's predecessor so the path can be reconstructed by walking backward.

optionExplanations: 对：每格只存一个前驱，把复制路径的成本推迟到最后一次回溯，热循环里最省。
错：每次入队都复制一份越变越长的路径，内存和时间都跟着膨胀。
错：只留数字丢了重建路径必需的信息，满足不了返回位置列表的要求。
错：visited 是无序集合，取不出有先后顺序的路径。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: storing one predecessor per cell defers the copy cost to a single final backtrace, the cheapest option in the hot loop.
Wrong: copying an ever-growing path on every enqueue bloats both memory and time.
Wrong: keeping only a number discards what's needed to rebuild the path, failing the list-of-positions requirement.
Wrong: visited is unordered, so an ordered path can't be recovered from it.

q: 补全示例路径长度理解：
q_en: Fill in the example path-length interpretation:
text: 示例中三颗星只是路径内部格子；完整路径还包含 {{S}} 和 {{E}}，所以总共有 {{5}} 个格子。
why: 很多实现会混淆边数和节点数；返回位置列表时端点也应该在列表中。
why_en: The returned path list includes both endpoints, so interior markers alone do not equal the full path length.

termDefinitions.meaning: 路径起点 S 和终点 E 这两个格子，返回的位置列表必须把它们都包含在内。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The endpoints are the start (S) and end (E) cells; the returned position list must include both.

scenario: 网格所有移动等权，BFS 用 FIFO 队列逐层扩展，visited 在入队时就标记。
scenario_en: All grid moves cost the same, BFS expands layer by layer with a FIFO queue, and visited is marked on enqueue.
q: BFS 第一次到达 E 就是最短路径，依赖哪些事实？（多选）
q_en: Which facts make the first BFS arrival at E the shortest path? (Select all that apply.)
options: 所有边代价相同
queue 按 FIFO 处理层级
visited 阻止重复扩展已经以更短或相同距离发现的格子
E 必须在矩阵右下角
options_en: All edges have equal cost
The queue processes layers in FIFO order
visited stops re-expanding cells already discovered at an equal or shorter distance
E must sit in the bottom-right corner of the grid
why: BFS 的层级顺序来自 FIFO 和单位边；位置无关，E 在哪里都一样。
why_en: BFS shortest-path correctness relies on equal edge costs, FIFO layer expansion, and not revisiting already discovered cells.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先进先出的处理顺序，队列的核心语义。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FIFO, First In First Out, means the first element added is the first one removed.

optionExplanations: 对：没有这个前提，层数就不再等于路径长度。
对：FIFO 保证扩展顺序严格按层推进，距离递增。
对：靠它防止之后更长的路径覆盖已经找到的更短结果。
错：正确性和 E 落在网格哪个位置完全无关。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: without equal-cost moves, layer number no longer equals path length.
Correct: FIFO guarantees expansion strictly advances layer by layer with increasing distance.
Correct: this stops a later, longer route from overwriting a shorter result already found.
Wrong: correctness has nothing to do with where E sits in the grid.

scenario: 运行环境不提供 deque，队列只能自己实现，但大迷宫要求出队保持 O(1)。
scenario_en: The runtime provides no deque, so you implement the queue yourself, yet big mazes still demand O(1) dequeue.
q: 环形缓冲队列和带 head index 的数组为什么也可以替代 deque？
q_en: Why can a ring-buffer queue or an array with a head index also replace deque?
options: 它们会改变 BFS 层序
它们自动生成 parent map
它们都能避免每次出队移动剩余元素
它们只适用于有权图
options_en: They would change the BFS layer order
They automatically generate the parent map
They both avoid shifting the remaining elements on every dequeue
They only work for weighted graphs
why: 关键不是容器名字，而是 enqueue/dequeue 都要是 O(1)；head 指针前移或 ring buffer 都满足这个操作模型。
why_en: Any queue implementation with constant-time enqueue and dequeue avoids the front-shifting cost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 固定大小、首尾下标可回绕的数组，入队出队都是 O(1)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A ring buffer is a fixed-size array whose head and tail indices wrap around, giving O(1) enqueue and dequeue.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用前移指针标记队头、丢弃前面槽位而不整体搬移的数组队列。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A head-index array marks the front with an advancing pointer, abandoning old slots instead of shifting the remaining elements.

termDefinitions.meaning: 支持两端 O(1) 插入删除的容器。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A deque supports O(1) insertion and removal at both ends.

optionExplanations: 错：层序由 FIFO 逻辑保证，跟底层容器怎么实现无关。
错：parent map 要单独维护，不是任何队列实现的副产品。
对：不管叫什么名字，只要两端操作是常数时间，就不用整体搬移剩余元素。
错：容器选择和图是否带权是两个独立的问题。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong: layer order comes from FIFO logic, unrelated to how the container is implemented underneath.
Wrong: the parent map must be maintained separately; no queue implementation produces it for free.
Correct: whatever it's called, as long as both ends run in constant time, nothing has to shift the remaining elements.
Wrong: container choice and whether the graph is weighted are independent questions.

scenario: 迷宫是固定 rows×cols 的二维数组，Position 是 `(r, c)`，你想进一步降低 visited 的常数开销。
scenario_en: The maze is a fixed rows-by-cols grid, Position is `(r, c)`, and you want to reduce visited's constant overhead.
q: 除了 hash set，还可以考虑什么？
q_en: What else can you consider besides a hash set?
options: 每次遍历整张 grid 查找是否访问
把 visited 存成逗号分隔字符串
完全去掉 visited
二维布尔数组 `visited[r][c]`
options_en: Scan the entire grid every time to check if a cell was visited
Store visited as a comma-separated string
Drop the visited tracking entirely
A two-dimensional boolean array `visited[r][c]`
why: 固定网格可以用二维布尔表 O(1) 标记和查询；文章用 set 是因为 Position 可哈希且实现简单。
why_en: A fixed grid can use a two-dimensional boolean array for constant-time visited checks with low overhead.
whenOtherWins: 如果坐标空间稀疏或不是规则矩阵，hash set 更通用。
tradeoff: 低常数的二维数组 vs 通用的 hash set

termDefinitions.meaning: 基于哈希表实现的集合，平均 O(1) 判断成员是否存在。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash set is a set backed by a hash table, giving average constant-time membership checks.

optionExplanations: 错：每次判重都要重扫整张网格，单次就是 O(V)，总成本退回平方级，比 hash set 还糟。
错：字符串拼接再子串匹配又慢又容易误判部分坐标重合。
错：不记录访问过的格子，BFS 会无限重复扩展同一批格子。
对：坐标固定又稠密时，按下标直接寻址的布尔表比哈希表常数更低。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong: rescanning the whole grid on every check is O(V) each time, pushing total cost back to quadratic — worse than the hash set it's meant to improve on.
Wrong: joining coordinates into a string and substring-matching is slow and prone to false partial matches.
Wrong: with no visited tracking, BFS would re-expand the same cells endlessly.
Correct: on a fixed, dense grid, an index-addressed boolean table beats a hash table's constant factor.

scenario: 优化版 BFS 用 deque 队列、hash set visited 和 parent 字典，迷宫有 V 个可达格子。
scenario_en: The optimized BFS uses a deque queue, a hash-set visited, and a parent dict over V reachable cells.
q: 优化版 BFS 的空间复杂度主要来自哪里？
q_en: Where does the optimized BFS space complexity mainly come from?
options: visited/parent/queue 三个结构合计占用 O(V)
用递归实现，栈深度可能达到 O(2^V) 这种指数级别，远超线性
需要对邻接表排序，成本是 O(E log E)，比线性扫描慢很多
BFS 完全不使用任何额外内存，所有状态都是隐式的
options_en: visited, parent, and queue together add up to O(V)
A recursive implementation whose stack depth could reach the exponential O(2 to the V)
Sorting an adjacency list, costing O(E log E), much slower than a linear scan
BFS uses no extra memory whatsoever; all state is implicit
why: 每个可达格子最多在 visited 和 parent 中出现一次，queue 最坏也可达到 O(V)。
why_en: The visited set, parent map, and queue together store at most a linear number of cells.
optionExplanations: 对：visited、parent、queue 三个结构合起来，每个可达格子最多贡献常数份空间。
错：BFS 是迭代实现，没有这种指数级的递归栈深度。
错：BFS 完全不需要给边排序，这不是它的开销来源。
错：queue、visited、parent 三个结构明显都在占用内存。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: visited, parent, and queue together contribute at most a constant amount of space per reachable cell.
Wrong: BFS is implemented iteratively, so there's no such exponential recursion stack.
Wrong: BFS never needs to sort edges, so that isn't where its cost comes from.
Wrong: the queue, visited, and parent structures obviously consume memory.

q: 把文章的性能修复路线排成正确顺序：
q_en: Put the performance-fix path in the correct order:
steps: 发现大迷宫上 list queue 和 list visited 导致 O(V^2)
保留 BFS 算法不变
把 queue 换成 O(1) 出队结构
把 visited 换成 O(1) membership 结构
大迷宫运行时间降到线性级预算内
why: BFS 算法本身是对的，修复点是让底层数据结构兑现 BFS 的线性复杂度。
why_en: The fix keeps BFS but replaces the containers so the implementation achieves the intended linear complexity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按层扩展的图搜索算法，用队列保证先发现的节点先被处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BFS, or Breadth-First Search, expands nodes layer by layer using a queue so earlier-discovered nodes are processed first.

scenario: 小迷宫只有几十个格子，V 很小；list 版和 deque+set 版在这种规模下耗时都在毫秒以下。
scenario_en: Small mazes have only a few dozen cells, so V is tiny; both list and deque-plus-set versions run under a millisecond at that scale.
q: 在小迷宫上，list BFS 和 deque+set BFS 为什么差距很小？
q_en: Why is the gap between list BFS and deque-plus-set BFS small on tiny mazes?
options: 因为 V 很小，O(V^2) 的常数尚未显现
因为 list 在小输入上是 O(1)，大输入上才变 O(V)
因为小迷宫不需要 visited
因为 deque 会故意变慢
options_en: Because V is small, the O(V squared) constant has not shown up yet
Because list operations are O(1) on small input and only become O(V) on large input
Because small mazes do not need a visited set
Because deque deliberately runs slower
why: 几十个格子时移动和扫描的绝对成本很低；只有测试大迷宫才会把 O(V^2) 和 O(V) 的差距放大到能被观察到——这就是为何小型单测不能验证容器选择是否正确。
why_en: Small mazes have so few cells that quadratic container overhead is too small to matter visibly.

termDefinitions.meaning: 时间随节点数 V 的平方增长的复杂度记号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: O(V squared) means the cost grows with the square of V, the number of vertices.

optionExplanations: 对：V 很小时，O(V^2) 里的常数项还没被放大到能被感知的程度。
错：list 的 pop(0) 和 membership 一直都是 O(V)，只是 V 小时绝对耗时很低，并没有变成 O(1)。
错：小迷宫同样需要 visited，否则也会重复扩展甚至死循环。
错：deque 没有被故意拖慢，它本来就比 list 快。
optionExplanations_en: Correct: when V is tiny, the constant factor inside O(V squared) hasn't been amplified enough to notice yet.
Wrong: list's pop(0) and membership are always O(V) — small V just keeps the absolute time low, it doesn't become O(1).
Wrong: small mazes still need visited, or they'd also re-expand cells or loop forever.
Wrong: deque isn't deliberately slowed down — it's simply faster than list by design.

scenario: 迷宫以后还要加传送门、冰面这类新格子规则，而 BFS 主循环希望一行都不改。
scenario_en: The maze will later add new cell rules like portals and ice, and the BFS main loop should not change at all.

return queue  # 此时 queue 里剩下的是还没处理完的 frontier 格子集合，根本不是最终确定下来的路径
